name: Prime Builder
author: Nexiby LLC

sections.description:
Prime Builder is a powerful WordPress plugin that extends the capabilities of Elementor, allowing you to create custom headers, footers, archive pages, single post/page templates, and other theme parts directly within the Elementor editor. With Prime Builder, you gain complete control over your website’s layout and design without writing a single line of code.

Key Features:
* Drag-and-Drop Interface: Build every part of your theme visually with Elementor.
* Custom Headers & Footers: Design unique headers and footers that apply globally or conditionally.
* Archive & Single Page Templates: Create custom layouts for your blog posts, pages, custom post types, and archives.
* Conditional Display: Assign templates to specific pages, posts, categories, tags, or other conditions.
* Lightweight & Optimized: Built for performance and compatibility with Elementor.

Resources

This plugin bundles the following third-party libraries:

  1. MicroModal.js
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prime-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated for Prime Builder to function correctly.
  4. Navigate to Prime Builder > Theme Builder to start creating your custom templates.
sections.faq:
What is Prime Builder?

Prime Builder is a WordPress plugin that integrates with Elementor to provide a comprehensive theme building solution. It allows you to design and manage various parts of your website’s theme, such as headers, footers, and page templates, using Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface.

Does Prime Builder require Elementor Pro?

While Prime Builder works seamlessly with Elementor Pro for advanced features, it is designed to function with the free version of Elementor as well. Some advanced conditional display options might require Elementor Pro features.

How do I create a custom header?

After activating Prime Builder and Elementor, go to Prime Builder > Theme Builder, click “Add New”, select “Header” as the template type, and design your header using Elementor. You can then set display conditions for where this header should appear.

Can I use Prime Builder with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Prime Builder is designed to work with any standard WordPress theme. It takes over the rendering of specific theme parts (like header, footer, single, archive) that you design with Elementor.
